scripts.build: bun build src/server.ts src/ops.ts src/image-preprocessing.ts src/image-preprocessing-worker.ts --target bun --outdir dist --external sharp --external @techstark/opencv-js && rm -rf dist/review dist/admin && bun build src/review-client.tsx src/review-theme.ts --target browser --outdir dist/review && mv dist/review/review-client.js dist/review/client.js && mv dist/review/review-theme.js dist/review/theme.js && bunx @tailwindcss/cli -i src/review-client.css -o dist/review/client.css && mkdir dist/review/files && cp node_modules/@fontsource/noto-sans-arabic/files/noto-sans-arabic-arabic-400-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/noto-sans-arabic/files/noto-sans-arabic-arabic-700-normal.woff2 dist/review/files && bun build src/admin-client.tsx src/review-theme.ts --target browser --outdir dist/admin && mv dist/admin/admin-client.js dist/admin/client.js && mv dist/admin/review-theme.js dist/admin/theme.js && bunx @tailwindcss/cli -i src/admin-client.css -o dist/admin/client.css && mkdir dist/admin/files && cp node_modules/@fontsource/noto-sans-arabic/files/noto-sans-arabic-arabic-400-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/noto-sans-arabic/files/noto-sans-arabic-arabic-700-normal.woff2 dist/admin/files
scripts.verify-build: bun run build && test -f dist/server.js && test -f dist/ops.js && test -f dist/image-preprocessing.js && test -f dist/image-preprocessing-worker.js && test -f dist/review/client.js && test -f dist/review/theme.js && test -f dist/review/client.css && test -f dist/review/files/noto-sans-arabic-arabic-400-normal.woff2 && test -f dist/review/files/noto-sans-arabic-arabic-700-normal.woff2 && test -f dist/admin/client.js && test -f dist/admin/theme.js && test -f dist/admin/client.css && test -f dist/admin/files/noto-sans-arabic-arabic-400-normal.woff2 && test -f dist/admin/files/noto-sans-arabic-arabic-700-normal.woff2
